problems_fixed.what: Within-tier duplicate answer: bronze[0] (f(x)+6 -> y=9) and bronze[2] (f(x-3) -> x=9) both answered 9. Changed the horizontal shift from f(x-3) to f(x-5) so the x-coordinate is 6+5=11, breaking the collision. Rewrote the misconception with a derivable expect (left-shift error 6-5=1).

Within-tier duplicate answer: silver[2] (f(x+2)-3 -> y=-4) and silver[4] (vector (0,-4), constant -4) both answered -4. Changed the translation vector from (0,-4) to (0,-5) so the constant term is -5, breaking the collision. Rewrote the misconception (read -5 as up 5, expect 5).

Inline theme-safe SVG shows the kite and its dashed mirror image marked '?'.
